tools/dasm.exe (DASM macro assembler, prebuilt Windows binary v2.20.17)

Copyright (c) 1988-2002 by Matthew Dillon, (c) 1995 by Olaf "Rhialto"
Seibert, (c) 2003-2008 by Andrew Davie, (c) 2008 by Peter H. Froehlich, and
contributors.
Source/releases: https://github.com/dasm-assembler/dasm

Licensed under the GNU General Public License v2.0 (GPL-2.0). Full license
text: https://github.com/dasm-assembler/dasm/blob/master/LICENSE

dasm.exe is used here only as an offline build tool (assembling generated
6502 source into a .sid file during MIDI-to-SID conversion) - it is not
linked into SIDIMIDI and does not become part of the compiled application.
Using a GPL-licensed compiler/assembler as a build tool does not place the
GPL on its input or output; the assembled .sid files it produces are not a
"derived work" of dasm itself.
